default.title: Obtain the Sinner
default.text: From the darkness... I have divined your arrival at this very moment... A well-destined sign... It pleases me...

default.title: Raise to Phase 1
default.text: The pursuit of death... is the pursuit of life...

default.title: Raise to Phase 3
default.text: Heaven and earth evolve to form the four seasons. Burn away the dead branches for the rise of new life!

default.title: Level Start
default.text: In ill fortune, we do not wage war. When times favor us, we advance. This battle... is ours to win.

default.title: Victory
default.text: When one is always at peace within, the world shall return to harmony.

default.title: Lose Battles
default.text: There is still room for redemption...

default.title: Ultimate Skill
default.text: At the end of decline, all shall rise again.

default.title: Die in Battles
default.text: It suffices to heed heaven's order...

default.title: Greeting
default.text: Ah... did you bring this auspicious omen, or... are you the omen, young friend?

default.title: Conversation 1
default.text: This gourd does not contain medicine... but the will of heaven and earth...

default.title: Conversation 2
default.text: The third time is the charm... Help me look... Where did that third copper coin go?

default.title: Conversation 3
default.text: What we seek, in our every return and departure, is merely to solve the mystery of this world, and to trace a line between death and life...

default.title: Special Conversation 1
default.text: Perhaps... immortality and annihilation... are just different destinations... that people long for.

default.title: Special Conversation 2
default.text: Once one understands... the meaning of death... they no longer need to fear it.

default.title: Special Conversation 3
default.text: When the flesh perishes, the spirit returns to nature, swallowed by heaven, earth, sun, and moon... We continue our endless search here... I only hope you might join us, young friend... in finding the ultimate meaning...

default.title: Full Compliance
default.text: Rip the talisman, ring the copper bell... You, the living bound by red thread, shall guide us through death... If I can return to you, please... bind us as one once more...

default.title: Idle
default.text: The Way gave rise to One, One to Two, Two to Three, Three to... Three lifetimes... That's not a very long time...

default.title: Annoyed
default.text: ...Young friend, this is... rather improper... Beware of... fatal disaster.

default.title: Special Attention
default.text: I have consulted heaven and earth... and asked my heart... It's the only reason I can withstand such a gaze from you, young friend... Eyes that seek to know all the divine secrets...

default.title: Dispatch
default.text: Those who chase the divine will must wander the world and observe all lives.

default.title: Dispatch Complete
default.text: A fruitful harvest... I've come to share it with you, young friend.

default.title: Level Up
default.text: ...Thank you, young friend. May boundless fortune be upon you.

default.title: Pat Head
default.text: Ah... "a lover's gentle touch upon thy head." I wonder if it really foretells... "an eternal life together"?
